description: The file is a Perl script designed to parse and manipulate Linux kernel configuration files, specifically those with the 'Kconfig' style or similar format. It includes functions to load configurations, compare them, add or subtract configuration settings, and parse configuration expressions.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value in a hash based on various conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from a given file into a hash.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Performs logical AND operation on two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes with optional modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Determines differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts configuration settings of one hash from another.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line based on its value.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Outputs the entire configuration hash in a formatted manner.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Recursively parses configuration expressions for logical and arithmetic operations.
